_doc: Drugs and alcohol (Trello rPBKwc8P, docs/systems/DRUGS_STAGE1_PLAN.md). Read only by Fenia (dreamland_fenia utils/drugs) through .config("fight/drugs"). Stage 1 ships the shared addiction engine and alcohol. Units: T (tolerance), D (dependence) and S (overdose strain) run 0-100 and are stored x10 in the PC string attribute 'drugs', so every gain and decay below is x10 too (10 = one point). Ticks are online heartbeats of 60 s. Every key is a plain identifier on purpose; liquid lists are comma-separated names. Stage 3 (docs/systems/DRUGS_STAGE3_PLAN.md) adds weed, tobacco, mushroom, agaric, opium and forage. cap_cm: a new high is scaled down so the sum of positive centi-M budgets of all highs on a character stays at cap_cm (.tmp.drug.budgetCap).

con._doc: T, D and S gain percent = 100 + (avg - con) * pct, clamped min..max: high constitution builds a habit slower and has more overdose headroom.

dependence._doc: D edges of the stages: clean below habit, habit, dependent, addict. A notice line when D crosses each edge upward. The dependence affect shows from habit; at addict it carries the addict_lines (stats, heal_gain) whatever the char is drinking.

perk._doc: Hold your drink: battleragers (clan), these races and followers of these religions (space-separated names). refund_pct of each drink's drunk gain is taken back; hangover size and length are cut to hangover_pct. Dependence gain is untouched.

alcohol._doc: Stages by the drunk desire (0-96): tipsy from tipsy, drunk from drunk, wasted from wasted, cap = the desire's maxValue. extra_alcohol: liquids without a beer/wine/liquor flag that still count as alcohol (hair of the dog, vampires). Only liquor-flagged liquids strain at the cap and can kill.

gain._doc: x10. Crossing into drunk: tolerance and dependence; into wasted: more dependence. sick_pct multiplies D gain while a hangover or withdrawal is on. Doses that are not self-dosed (spiked cup, charmed or ordered) give no D.

tolerance._doc: Buff lines and the drink berserk level are cut to (100 - pml * t / 100) percent, floor floor_pct, t = T stored x10 (pml 7: 0.7 percent per T point). T drops decay (x10) per decay_every clean ticks.

stages._doc: Per stage: cm = centi-M budget of the buff lines at the char's level, split hp:damroll by hp/dr shares (item_value armor prices, tolerance applied). Debuffs (hitroll, dex, saves) are counts at debuff_level, scaled by level / debuff_level, at least 1. luck: + this on .tmp.chance (tipsy only). fearless: refused by fear. slur: percent of letters in channel speech (C++ caps it at 40). stagger: percent per room entered. sing, vomit, passout: percent per heartbeat, never in a fight.

hangover._doc: Starts when a session that peaked at peak or more falls under end. Ticks = peak / ticks_div, at most ticks_max; lines grow by 2 percent per D point (1 + D/50). Thirst drops thirst per tick. Sleeping ticks count double. cures: comma lists of liquids that take cure_ticks or weak_ticks off per drink. cure poison halves what is left.

overdose._doc: Reaching the cap on any alcohol: alcohol poisoning (poison power, forced vomit, passing out sleep_min..sleep_max ticks). Each liquor sip that lands at the cap adds strain (x10, times conScale). Strain decays per tick. A plain warning at warn1 and at warn2; strain is held at hold until both were shown this session; death at death, self-dosed liquor only.

withdrawal._doc: From D dependent, sober and hangover over: ticks online ticks. Lines by D: dependent or addict. Reaching tipsy pauses it and adds taper ticks once. Delirium tremens (D addict): the first dt_ticks ticks, a hallucination line at most every dt_every ticks, seizure_pct per tick (luck-avoided). comfort: drinks that make the lines one step milder for comfort_ticks. Healer detox mutes the lines for detox_ticks.

vampire._doc: Drunk blood: percent of the vampire's max hp lost per feeding by the victim's stage, no heal, lethal. Wasted blood also poisons (poison power). A vampire's own sip of alcohol costs sip_pct of max hp and makes it vomit.

fisstech._doc: Stage 2 (docs/systems/DRUGS_STAGE2_PLAN.md 3.2, decisions in section 9). One pinch (obj 30282, behavior drug, props sub fisstech) is one dose: a high (affect fisstech), then a crash (affect comedown). Same x10 units and con scaling as alcohol. combo_pct: tipsy or worse at the dose makes the high that much longer and multiplies strain and D gain of both records. Item: rot ticks once a player holds a pinch.

gain._doc: x10, per dose, times conScale. sick_pct multiplies D gain when dosing during a high, a crash or a withdrawal. Not self-dosed (laced cup, charmed): no D. Blood from a high victim: D times blood.d_pct, never strain.

tolerance._doc: As alcohol: the high (ticks and budget) is cut to (100 - pml * t / 100) percent, floor floor_pct. T drops decay (x10) per decay_every clean ticks.

high._doc: Affect fisstech, ticks long, all of it times tolerance. cm: centi-M budget split by shares (.tmp.drug.budget). lines: fixed lines on top (beats has no price row, counted as about 30 cM, so the high is about 110 cM). haste: the haste bit, only when T (x10) was under haste_t before the dose, dropped for battleragers. Debuffs: counts at debuff_level, scaled by level, times (1 + D/50). A dose strips fatigue; asleep while high wakes at the next tick; boast_pct per tick a boastful say, never in a fight.

crash._doc: Affect comedown when the high runs out, ticks long, lines times (1 + D/50), a craving line. A new dose clears it and starts a new high at the current tolerance.

overdose._doc: x10. Each dose adds strain (times conScale). Each drink while high adds booze_strain per point of drunk the sip adds (times conScale; 3: a sober-to-drunk evening, about 80 points, is about 240). Strain decays per tick. Warnings at warn1 and warn2 (text only); strain is held at hold until both were shown; death at death, self-dosed only. After every dose or drink that strains, a heart attack roll in permille: 0 up to heart_from, then 1000 * ((strain - heart_from) / (death - heart_from)) squared, times conScale / 100, at most heart_cap; luck-avoided. A pinch rolls these full odds; a drink rolls them times the strain it added / strain (one pinch), so an evening of drinks weighs about one pinch. It costs heart_min_pct..heart_max_pct of max hp and heart_lag rounds of lag, and can kill (decision 9), but never on a dose or drink that is not self-dosed.

withdrawal._doc: As alcohol, no delirium (no dt_ticks). From D dependent, not high and not crashing: ticks online ticks, lines by D. A dose pauses it and adds taper ticks once. comfort drinks make the lines a step milder for comfort_ticks. Healer detox mutes them for detox_ticks.

tell._doc: look at a user with D (x10) at least nose_d shows a red, runny nose.

blood._doc: A vampire feeding on a PC high on fisstech: a high of high_pct strength, D gain times d_pct percent, never strain.

weed._doc: Stage 3 (docs/systems/DRUGS_STAGE3_PLAN.md 3.3, decisions in section 9). One dose is a high (affect weed), then a crash (affect comedown). The form (toke, edible, joint) is prototype data in props.drug (sub, pct strength, onset ticks, keep, daily), not here. Same x10 units and con scaling as alcohol. Battleragers get every line (all organic). stagger_pct: a weed high multiplies the drunk stagger chance by this percent.

gain._doc: x10, per dose at 100 percent strength, times conScale. sick_pct multiplies D gain when dosing during a high, a crash or a withdrawal. Not self-dosed: no D.

tolerance._doc: As fisstech: the high is cut to (100 - pml * t / 100) percent, floor floor_pct. T drops decay (x10) per decay_every clean ticks.

high._doc: Affect weed, ticks long, times tolerance and strength. scaled: counts at scale_level, scaled by level (about 10 cM). regen: the regeneration bit, only while the user sits, rests or sleeps, checked each tick (priced at a quarter of its 0.80 M, so the high is about 30 cM). lines: fixed costs. hunger: extra hunger points drained a tick. giggle_pct per tick a giggle, never in a fight. fearless: refused by fear.

crash._doc: The shared affect comedown when the high runs out, ticks long.

greenout._doc: x10. Each dose adds strain (times strength), strain decays per tick. At at: vomit, forced rest for rest_ticks, strain cleared. No warning, never a death. A second edible during the onset wait stacks its strain.

withdrawal._doc: As fisstech. From D dependent, not high and not crashing: ticks online ticks, lines by D. A dose pauses it and adds taper ticks once.

softens._doc: A dose during a hangover, a fisstech crash or any withdrawal sets the existing comfort step (one step milder) for comfort_ticks.

blood._doc: A vampire feeding on a PC high on weed: a high of high_pct strength, D gain times d_pct percent, never strain.

tobacco._doc: Stage 3 (DRUGS_STAGE3_PLAN.md 3.4). A smoke (use) or a chew (eat, plug 1103) is one dose: a plain smoke (affect tobacco), and once a day the first-cigarette rush. No crash, no overdose, no blood. Battleragers get everything, the rush included.

gain._doc: x10, per smoke, times conScale. About 25 smokes to dependent.

tolerance._doc: As fisstech. The plain smoke is cut to (100 - pml * t / 100) percent, floor floor_pct; the rush is not.

high._doc: Affect tobacco, ticks long: fixed lines, about 8 cM.

rush._doc: Affect nicotine rush, ticks long, bits from the detect_flags and affect_flags tables. Any tobacco gives it once per real day (record field fd). The Songs butt (object butt) gives it once per game day on its own stamp (field gd). Organic.

mushroom._doc: Stage 3 (DRUGS_STAGE3_PLAN.md 3.5, 3.6). One liberty cap (27911) or Amber's magic mushrooms (37054) is one dose: onset ticks of nothing, then a trip (affect mushroom trip) in one of four visions, then a crash (affect comedown). No dependence. Battleragers keep wis, mana_gain, the void and retargets; slevel, the detects and astral walk are not organic. retarget_pct: percent of the tripper's targeted commands that land on someone else in the room (is_safe refuses); commands in retarget_skip (resolved English names) are never touched. flashback: from flashback_trips lifetime trips, flashback_pct per sober tick a flashback line, flavour only.

gain._doc: x10, per mushroom, times conScale. No D.

tolerance._doc: The trip is cut to (100 - pml * t / 100) percent, floor floor_pct (pml 15: 1.5 percent per T point, so a second mushroom the same hour does close to nothing). T drops decay (x10) per decay_every ticks.

trip._doc: Affect mushroom trip, ticks long, base lines for every vision: lines fixed, debuffs at debuff_level scaled by level. hallu_every: one hallucination line per that many ticks at most, never in a fight.

visions._doc: Weights of the vision rolled at onset. void_weight adds to void: on a fisstech high, drunk or worse, onset in a fight, on a weed high (negative). Then the four are rescaled to 100. Every shift_every ticks a shift_pct roll rerolls the vision from the other three.

flow._doc: The Flow: slevel (not organic) and mana_gain on top of the base lines.

sight._doc: True sight: the detect bits in detect, plus one of extra at random. Not organic.

astral._doc: Astral walk: the skill lent at pct percent (giveTemporary, origin fenia), taken back when the vision shifts or ends. The vision is forced to shift after shift_after ticks. Not organic.

void._doc: Void stare: on entry lose mana_loss_pct of current mana; hitroll and damroll minus level / hd_div; saves; the dark line pool. Never filtered.

mushroom.retarget_skip: say tell reply gtell yell emote gossip ic ooc grats music rtalk cb mtalk note use eat look

second._doc: A second mushroom during the onset wait or the trip: ticks added to the trip and the vision forced to vision.

crash._doc: The shared affect comedown after the trip, ticks long.

blood._doc: A vampire feeding on a tripping PC: a trip of ticks_pct length with its own vision roll.

agaric._doc: Stage 3 (DRUGS_STAGE3_PLAN.md 3.7). One fly agaric (27912) is one dose: onset ticks, then affect fly agaric. Berserkers (subclass) get the rage block, everyone else the toxic block. No dependence, no blood.

gain._doc: x10, per dose, times conScale. No D.

tolerance._doc: As fisstech: the effect is cut to (100 - pml * t / 100) percent, floor floor_pct. T drops decay (x10) per decay_every ticks.

berserker._doc: Affect fly agaric for a berserker, ticks long. cm centi-M split by shares (.tmp.drug.budget). berserk started during it lasts rage_pct percent. Cannot flee. Debuffs at debuff_level, scaled by level. Everything organic.

toxic._doc: Affect fly agaric for everyone else, ticks long: poison of poison_power, a vomit, debuffs at debuff_level scaled by level, the dark line pool.

crash._doc: The shared affect comedown when it runs out. vomit_pct per tick, never in a fight.

overdose._doc: x10. Each dose adds strain, strain decays per tick. From toxic_at the dose also poisons like a pale toadstool (forage.deathcap poison only). Never lethal.

opium._doc: Stage 3 (DRUGS_STAGE3_PLAN.md 3.10). One ball (object ball, smoked with use) is one dose: a high (affect opium), then a crash (affect comedown). The caster premium drug. Sold by the keepers (mob vnums, props.shopper gate opium) at price silver, cap balls per buyer per game day across all keepers; never to a newbie, and a newbie cannot use a ball. Item: rot ticks once a player holds a ball.

gain._doc: x10, per dose, times conScale. sick_pct multiplies D gain when dosing during a high, a crash or a withdrawal. Not self-dosed: no D.

high._doc: Affect opium, ticks long, times tolerance. cm centi-M split by shares (.tmp.drug.budget, mana 60 and hp 20 cM). lines: fixed (slevel not organic). scaled: counts at scale_level, scaled by level (saves about 25 cM; about 125 cM in all). debuffs: at debuff_level, scaled by level, times (1 + D/50). nod_pct per tick, out of a fight, the user nods off to sleep. fearless: refused by fear.

crash._doc: The shared affect comedown when the high runs out, ticks long, lines times (1 + D/50).

overdose._doc: x10, the fisstech rule (odRisk, odAttack). Each dose adds strain (times conScale), times the row combo_strain_pct when tipsy or worse at the dose, times the row cross.<other> percent on whichever of opium and fisstech comes second. Each drink while high adds booze_strain per drunk point. Strain decays per tick. Warnings at warn1 and warn2; held at hold until both were shown; death at death, self-dosed only. After every dose that strains, a stopped-breath roll on the heart curve from heart_from, at most heart_cap, luck-avoided: it costs heart_min_pct..heart_max_pct of max hp and attack_sleep ticks out cold, and kills a user with no more health than that.

withdrawal._doc: As fisstech, lines by D. cramp_pct (addict only): per tick the user drops to resting and loses a round, luck-avoided, no delirium lines.

tell._doc: look at a user with D (x10) at least pupils_d shows pinpoint pupils.

blood._doc: A vampire feeding on a PC high on opium: a high of high_pct strength, D gain times d_pct percent, never strain.

forage._doc: Stage 3 (DRUGS_STAGE3_PLAN.md 3.8, 3.9). Wild mushrooms: five kinds (object vnum, share of rain sprouts), all disguised as a wild mushroom until identified on get. toadstool and deathcap are dose entries only, no record.

rain._doc: In the land.are rain loop, a forest room that passed its 1 percent roll sprouts one mushroom on a sprout_pct roll, outside winter. A sprout rots after rot ticks. No sprout while the world holds world_cap of the five kinds.

identify._doc: On get, one roll per picker per mushroom through .tmp.chance: herbs percent / herbs_div + (wis - wis_base) * wis_mul, held to min..max.

spots._doc: Old mushroom reset rooms, by group, space-separated vnums. spotsTick grows a kind by its group's weights in a room with no mushroom patch affect and none of the five kinds on the floor; a picked spot gets affect mushroom patch until it regrows.

growth._doc: Mushroom patch growth: one onUpdateRoom call in every does the work, adding clear, cloudy, rain or storm by the sky (cave rooms always add cave); winter outdoors cuts it to winter_pct. At regrow the affect strips itself: about 2 real hours dry, 40 minutes in rain.

toadstool._doc: False liberty cap and panther cap: poison of poison_power, a vomit, hunger emptied. cure poison works.

deathcap._doc: Pale toadstool: after delay ticks of nothing, poison of poison_power and hp_min_pct..hp_max_pct of max hp. Kills only the self-dosed (raw_kill label toadstool); fed on orders or charmed, it stops at 1 hp. No newbie exemption.

peddler._doc: The night peddler (mob 30281, behaviors shopper and peddler). Lives in room home of the Cloud of Precious Smoke by day; at night (.sunlight 0) stands in one of spots (room vnums, never last night's), back home at dawn. The shop charges the pinch's object cost (30282, price in silver, 30000 = 300 gold) through props.shopper; price here must match it. cap: pinches per buyer per game night, cap_thief for thieves. gift: a free pinch once per life, only when the player asks.

law._doc: Cities that ban fisstech, by area file name (area.filename), space-separated; everything else tolerates. A city guard who picks a passer-by for a talk frisks instead when the passer-by is high or carries a pinch in the open (top-level inventory, not in a container); avoided with luck at 100 - frisk_pct. Never a sleeper, a fighter or a Ruler. High with no open pinch: a warning and loyalty -high_loyalty. Pinches found: taken, loyalty -frisk_loyalty, and a fine in silver paid in full (newbies pay none); who cannot pay it becomes wanted when broke_wanted is 1, at loyalty -50 instead of frisk_loyalty. A pinch received by give within the last plant_ticks ticks is not counted. Stage 3: ban stays the fisstech list; ban_opium and ban_weed list the cities that ban those (lawBans(area, sub) reads ban_<sub>, falling back to ban for fisstech). One frisk takes every banned dose in the open and charges one fine, the largest found: fine for fisstech and opium, fine_weed for weed. Weed alone (the petty tier: any sub with a fine_<sub> key) costs minor_loyalty and never makes anyone wanted; a weed high alone is ignored.

law.ban_opium: midgaard.are smidgaard.are shire.are gerghlm2.are solace.are ofcol2.are titan.are
